# Ragunauth Ramsaroop

> Official public professional website for Ragunauth "Randy" Ramsaroop. The site covers ESG, social responsibility, corporate affairs, government relations, governance, responsible mining, stakeholder engagement, energy transition and natural resources.

Official website: https://ragunauthramsaroop.com/
Current confirmed role: Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc. | 2025-Present
AGM public tenure: consolidated from 2020; earlier internal titles are omitted unless reconfirmed.
Public CV: https://ragunauthramsaroop.com/resume.html
Public record reviewed: 29 September 2026
